name: WCA-Bench
full_name: WCA-Bench: A Sports Analytics Benchmark from World Cube Association Competition Data
description: WCA-Bench is the first comprehensive machine-learning benchmark built on public World Cube Association (WCA) competition data. It covers result prediction, placement prediction, DNF prediction, human-limit estimation, and skill-transfer analysis under a leakage-free temporal evaluation protocol. The release ships decoded Parquet tables, frozen training-time statistics, and train/val/test index splits.
description_zh: WCA-Bench 是首个基于世界魔方协会（WCA）公开比赛数据的综合性机器学习基准，涵盖成绩预测、名次预测、DNF 预测、人类极限估计、技能迁移分析五类任务，并提供无泄漏的时间评估协议与冻结统计量。
